stem.text: Four potential divider circuits each consist of a battery of electromotive force (e.m.f.) $9\,\text{V}$ and negligible internal resistance connected to a combination of resistors. Each of the resistors in the circuits has a resistance of $X$ or $2X$.
Which circuit has the largest output voltage $V$?

A.alt: Circuit drawing: battery labelled 9 V, resistors labelled X and X, output labelled V.

B.alt: Circuit drawing: battery labelled 9 V, resistors labelled X and 2X, output labelled V.

C.alt: Circuit drawing: battery labelled 9 V, resistors labelled X, X and 2X, output labelled V.

D.alt: Circuit drawing: battery labelled 9 V, resistors labelled X, X and 2X, output labelled V.
